title: Can One Medium Potato a Day Boost Your Health?

scenes.text: One medium potato a day—what does it really do for you?
It delivers about 400 mg of potassium, supporting blood pressure and muscle function.
scenes.label: POTASSIUM BOOST

scenes.text: When cooled, it forms resistant starch, a fiber‑like carb that feeds good gut bacteria.
scenes.label: RESISTANT STARCH

scenes.text: It also provides vitamin C and dietary fiber, helping immunity and digestion.
scenes.label: VITAMIN C & FIBER

scenes.text: Follow for simple habits that boost your health.

description: A single potato does more than fill you up—learn three science‑backed benefits you can tap into every day. Try it and see the difference!
